content.text:
this repository is not placed in the layout pecot expects for a project
  
    current: /tmp/pecot-cli-MhSrRN/workspaces/misplaced/demo
    expected: /tmp/pecot-cli-MhSrRN/workspaces/misplaced/base/demo
  
  why base/ is needed:
    the devcontainer mounts the parallel sets (wt1, wt2...) selectively, so base/ separates the resident set from the parallel sets
  
  migration steps (the cwd goes away, so close this CLI session first):
    1. close this CLI session
    2. in another terminal, run:
         mkdir -p /tmp/pecot-cli-MhSrRN/workspaces/misplaced/base
         mv /tmp/pecot-cli-MhSrRN/workspaces/misplaced/demo /tmp/pecot-cli-MhSrRN/workspaces/misplaced/base/
    3. restart the CLI in /tmp/pecot-cli-MhSrRN/workspaces/misplaced/base/demo/
